notes.title: Pageant Steam Achievement fix and max prize removed
notes.notes:
Hey Pals! 🐟👋🐠
I found that the pageant prizes had an unexpected maximum award, so removed that ceiling and changed the way it detects the achievement. This should fix the bronze, silver and gold pageant achievements :)
Happy Achievement hunting fams 💖

Warmest regards
Matt And Linda
🐠 The Aqua Pals Team 🐟

notes.title: Cycle Of Life Update
notes.notes:

Birth: Baby fish - new fish are now baby fish! feed(and love) them enough and they will grow into adults
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/44ea775204a29d61f59351eb2713966d04765112.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/00a1cd653d418f7bbc91bc517c2e4bf97bddaffd.png[/img][/url]

	- Babies require a set number of food points to grow up.
	- New food added

notes.title: save game bug fixed
notes.notes:
When starting a new game, the game variables were not being reset entirely, which was causing unexpected behaviors. 
This build/fix should do the trick, apologies to anyone who experienced difficulties and thank you for the feedback 💖

notes.title: Wail on ya Space bar to speed up the confetti!
notes.notes: The pageant can't be skippable or it becomes a money hack so we took a fans suggestion to make spacebar speed up the confetti :) Each press will advance to the next frame of the animation.
